rationale: Mufaddal brings 15+ years of embedded systems and automotive software expertise (embedded Linux, Bluetooth, OTA architecture) while Symphony Creative Studio is building AI-powered video generation tools for creators and advertisers—representing a complementary pairing of deep infrastructure experience and cutting-edge generative AI product. At a Physical AI hackathon, Mufaddal's embedded systems and connectivity background could inform hardware-grounded AI applications, while the ByteDance PMM's perspective on consumer AI tooling and performance metrics offers practical product-market insight that complements infrastructure-level thinking.
intro_message: Mufaddal, meet the Product Marketing Manager at ByteDance's Symphony Creative Studio—you bring embedded systems and automotive-grade software delivery expertise; they're shipping generative AI video tools at scale, and exploring how those perspectives might intersect at this hackathon could be valuable.
